column1: # divergence-triage.tsv — the loop's memory of which divergent-copy candidates
# have already been JUDGED, so future iterations don't re-eyeball the same safe
# forks. Consumed by diff-divergent-fn.sh: `--scan` annotates each candidate with
# its status here; `--scan --new` shows ONLY untriaged (NEW) or re-drifted ones.
#   STATUS  = SAFE   (a legitimate fork of copies that are MEANT TO STAY IN SYNC —
#                     so a later sim change IS signal that one drifted and wants a
#           | FORK   (an INTENTIONAL per-app copy that is SUPPOSED to keep diverging:
#                     two apps' fetch interceptors, two endpoints' getDoc against
#                     different tables, etc. These ARE real related copies (unlike an
#                     IGNORE collision), but their drift is EXPECTED and carries no bug
#                     signal — so they are hidden PERMANENTLY, never re-flagged on sim
#                     drift. Use FORK (not SAFE) when the two copies are deliberately
#                     different per context and re-reviewing them every scan is pure
#                     recurring noise. SIM is reference-only on FORK rows.)
#           | IGNORE (NOT a divergent copy at all — a same-name COLLISION: N
#                     unrelated functions that merely share a generic identifier,
#                     brace extractor pairs their unrelated bodies and reports a
#                     coincidental overlap, so they can never be a "stale twin".)
#   SIM_AT_TRIAGE = the scan's body-overlap % when judged. If the live scan later
#     reports a DIFFERENT sim for a SAFE name, the fork drifted further since the
#     judgment — diff-divergent-fn.sh re-flags it as "SAFE↻ re-review", so a newly
#     introduced bug in a previously-safe copy can't hide behind an old verdict.
#     IGNORE and FORK rows are EXEMPT from this re-review: for IGNORE the collision
#     overlap is meaningless and drifts constantly; for FORK the drift is deliberate.
#     Both hide permanently regardless of sim. (SIM is recorded for reference only on
#   REASON  = one line on WHY it's safe / a collision (or what the bug is).
# Add a row the moment you finish judging a candidate. Keep reasons short.
# A name whose copies get CONSOLIDATED to identical simply stops appearing in the
# scan (no row needed); leave its row or delete it, both are harmless.
